A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Lacag ah Kulottunga I (1070-1120 CE), kaas oo mideeyay khadadka Chola iyo Bariga Chalukya oo xukumay mid ka mid ah xukunnada Chola ee ugu dheer uguna barwaaqo badan. Lacagtiisu waxay sii wadaa noocyada Chola ee la aasaasay oo magaciisa ku yaal Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Lacag ka mid ah Rajaraja I. Lacagtiisa naxaasta ah ee boqorka taagan iyo nooca fadhiga, oo la soo bandhigay ka dib markii uu qabsaday waqooyiga Sri Lanka, ayaa si ballaaran ugu wareegay labada dhinac ee badda waxaana lagu dayday qarniyo.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Lacag ka mid ah boqortooyada Jaffna oo muujinaysa faras kalluun leh. Boqorradii Tamil ee Jaffna (qarnigii 13-aad-17aad) waxay soo saareen qadaadiic dhaqanka Koonfurta Hindida, xusuusin xiriirkii dhowaa ee ka jiray Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Lacag ka mid ah Kongu Cheras, khadka Chera ee xukumay waddanka Kongu ee galbeedka Tamil (qiyaastii maanta Coimbatore, Erode iyo Karur) - isla gobolkaas oo soo saaray kayd qani ah oo qadaadiic Roman ah.

A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Weel duug ah oo laga soo qaaday saqafka lagu aaso ee buuraha Nilgiri, daboolkiisuna waxaa ku xardhan sawirro qaabaysan. A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Lacag dahab ah oo Rajaraja I (985-1014 CE), oo dhisay macbadka weyn ee Thanjavur. A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Dahab nus-kahavanu ah ee Virarajendra Chola (1063-1070 CE). Kahavanu (oo ka soo jeeda kahapana) waxay ahayd diin dahab ah oo Sri Lanka ah, dahabka Chola wuxuu ku dhuftay heerkan wuxuu ka tarjumayaa muddada Chola ee jasiiradda.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Gabay tilmaame ah oo ka mid ah Tobanka Idylls ee Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar. Bard leh yazh weyn ayaa lagu hagayaa Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan ee Kanchi; Jidka dhexdiisa gabaygu wuxuu sawirayaa muuqaallo muuqaal ah oo tuulooyinka, dekedaha, iyo dadka.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Gabay hage ah oo ka mid ah Tobanka Idylls ee Mudathama Kanniyar. Bard garaaca durbaanka (porunar) oo si hodan ah loo abaalmariyay ayaa ku hagaya saaxiibkiis boqorka deeqsinimada leh ee Chola Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Gabay hage ah oo ka mid ah Tobanka Idylls ee Nallur Nathathanar. Bard ku ciyaara yazh yar (kataarad) ayaa mid kale u horseedaya caaqil Nalliyakkodan, isaga oo sharraxaya dhibka baarka faqiirka ah iyo diirimaad deeqsinimo leh.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Gabay hage ah oo ka mid ah Tobanka Idylls ee Perunkausikanar. Hawl-wadeennada wareegaya (koothar) waxa lagu hagayaa ugaaska Nannan; gabayga ayaa loogu dabbaaldegayaa qabashada dhawaaqyada badan ee buuraha.

A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Aaska weyn oo calooshiisa wareegsan oo ka yimid Adichanallur. A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Lacag qadaadiic ah oo ka timid Andipatti oo sita halyeey Tamil-Brahmi. A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Sawir khad ah oo vimana ah iyo hoolka tiirarka ee Macbadka Brihadisvara.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Gabay jacayl ah oo ka mid ah Tobanka Idylls ee Kapilar, oo ku yaal buurta (kurinji) muuqaalka. Dhaqanku wuxuu sheegay in loo qoray in la baro boqorka waqooyi quruxda gabayada jacaylka Tamil; waxay caan ku tahay sagaal iyo sagaashan ubax.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Sawirka farshaxanka casriga ah ee dekedda mashquulka ah ee maraakiibta, suuqyada iyo munaaradaha, ka dib sharraxaadaha Silappatikaram iyo Pattinappalai. Maaha caddayn sida dhabta ah ee magaaladu u ekaatay.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Sawir gacmeed casri ah oo sawiraya maraakiibta iyo dhismooyinka ku yaal dekedda qadiimiga ah. Sida dib-u-dhis kasta oo Puhar ah, waxay tarjumeysaa sharraxaadda suugaanta; qaabka buuxa ee dekedda lama yaqaan.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Magac ku xiran Nedunalvadai iyo Tirumurukarruppatai ee Tobanka Idylls - inkastoo laga yaabo inay ka tirsan yihiin wax ka badan hal gabayaa oo xilliyo kala duwan ah. A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Lacag Pandya ah oo ay ku jiraan kalluunka mataanaha ah iyo dibi. Kalluunka lammaanuhu wuxuu noqday astaanta Pandya ee waara, oo lagu xardhay boodhadhka Madurai ee gabayada oo ay ku garaaceen qadaadiicda in ka badan kun sano.

A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Gabay ka mid ah Tobanka Idylls ee Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar, oo ammaanaya boqorkii Chola Karikal Valavan iyo magaaladiisa mashquulka badan ee Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), maraakiibteeda, suuqyadeeda, iyo ciidaha.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Gabay ka mid ah Tobankii Idylls ee Nakkeerar. Inta lagu jiro dabaysha qabow ee waqooyi ee dheer, boqoradu waxay u xiisay ninkeeda halka boqorku uu ku daryeelo askartiisa ku dhaawacantay xero dagaal.

A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Dheef-shiid kiimikaad ku qornaa Tamil-Brahmi, oo laga helay Tissamaharama ee koonfurta Sri Lanka oo taariikhdeedu ahayd qiyaastii qarnigii 2aad ee BCE. A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Buug naadir ah oo laga soo bilaabo tobannaankii sano ee ugu horreeyay ee daabacaadda Tamil, markii qoraallada caadiga ah ee lagu xafiday caleemaha timirta la dhigay nooc markii ugu horreysay.

A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Lacagta Pandya ee Sangam-da ah, sida caadiga ah labajibbaaran yar oo naxaas ah oo maroodi dhinac ka yahay iyo kalluun qaabaysan oo dhinaca kale ah. A second image of the four-armed, seated: Sawirka labaad ee afar-gacan, oo fadhiya Ganesha. Is barbar dhig saamigeeda, qurxinta iyo leexashada jirridda marka hore: gudaha canon-ka la wadaago ee Silpa Sastras, farshaxan kasta iyo aqoon-is-weydaarsi kasta ayaa ka tagay taabashadeeda.

A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Koob dheri ah oo yar oo laga soo qaaday xabaalaha Adichanallur.
